annotations.title: Plan a journey by train and bus

description: Plan a GB journey that may combine trains, buses and short walks, between railway stations, bus stops or coordinates, from the timetables. Each place can be a station name or CRS code, a bus stop with its town (e.g. 'Briggate Leeds'), a stop code, or 'lat,lon'. Returns the next few ways after a time with every leg: mode, line or train, where to board and alight, and times. Timetabled, not live. For rail only, plan_journey is simpler.

date.description: Date, yyyy-MM-dd. Defaults to today (UK time).

from.description: Where from: station, bus stop with town, stop code, or 'lat,lon'.

time.description: Leave after this time, HH:mm UK time. Defaults to now.

to.description: Where to: station, bus stop with town, stop code, or 'lat,lon'.

name: plan_door_to_door
